case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Marek Lis,

Thank you for your quotation and your willingness to demonstrate reliable supply, which is central to our relationship. We acknowledge that our late payments have affected your cash flow.

Your defect rate over the last four quarters stands at 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Our demand forecast for this part has changed +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

We are flexible on the quality commitment: the strongest commitment earns the highest unit price, and all packages include no complaint charges. The focus is operational improvement rather than punitive cost cutting; which quality and price package works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 43.78 per unit, quality commitment 300 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.
Option B: EUR 43.55 per unit, quality commitment 800 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.
Option C: EUR 43.24 per unit, quality commitment 1500 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.

We value our relationship and want to support dependable production on workable terms.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We offer a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. We also have another package available: a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. 

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Thanks for the options, we can commit to the 1500 ppm target, but we need 46.50 EUR per unit for this package. Let's agree on this price so we can focus on improving the quality and getting the parts to you. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Marek Lis,

Thank you for adjusting your offer and providing the quality report; we recognise your need to protect margin and acknowledge the cash impact of our late payments. Faster payment matters to you, but this proposal changes neither payment terms nor our volume commitment.

We have made a modest price concession and ask for a price step in return, with flexibility on complaint charges to make your liability predictable. Option B provides the complaint-charge waiver you requested in exchange for the lower price; which package works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 44.19 per unit, EUR 500 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.
Option B: EUR 44.05 per unit, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.
Option C: EUR 44.09 per unit, EUR 150 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.

We appreciate your engagement and want to keep the focus on dependable quality and delivery.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
